# kr8tiv AI

> kr8tiv AI builds AI back-office systems for real businesses — receipt pipelines, same-day quoting with profitability checks, dispatch tracking, 6:30 AM operational digests, and MCP-native watchdog agents — wired into the tools a business already uses (spreadsheets, drive, email). Everything is open source and the company is tokenized: 75% of revenue flows to $KR8TIV holders, 5% to charity. Based in Edmonton, Alberta; working everywhere.

Contact: hello@kr8tiv.ai · +1-780-915-5471 · intake at https://kr8tiv.io/start/

## What we build

- AI Ops Audit: one week inside an operation, mapping where the hours go; deliverable is a written automation plan the client keeps either way.
- Back-Office Build: agents wired into the client's existing stack — automated receipt filing (photo → logged expense), quoting engines with break-even checks, dispatch from lead to invoice, morning digests, watchdog agents that flag unpaid invoices and unscheduled deposits.
- Care: ongoing tuning and new automations. No lock-in — the client owns the data, documents, and code.

## Proof

- Case study: Evolve Eco Blasting (Edmonton industrial surface restoration, https://evolveecoblasting.com) — one crew, zero office staff. kr8tiv AI built their complete operations layer on the spreadsheets and drive they already owned. Nothing was replaced.

## Products

- JARVIS — autonomous context engine; started as a live trading terminal on Solana, growing into a portable intelligence layer: https://jarvislife.io
- KIN — bespoke concierge AI companion on voice, Telegram, and WhatsApp: https://meetyourkin.com
